segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Lie down and make every practical adjustment now. Let the body be warm and supported. Yoga Nidra invites deep rest; you may remain awake or drift near sleep.

[soft, slow, warm voice] [faint greenhouse leaves rustling] Imagine lying inside a moonlit greenhouse where thousands of flowers are closing for the night. Feel the whole body resting as one quiet garden.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Bring attention to the right thumb... index finger... middle finger... ring finger... little finger... palm... back of the hand... wrist.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right forearm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit... right side of the ribs... waist... hip.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right thigh... knee... shin... calf... ankle... heel... sole... top of the foot... big toe... second... third... fourth... little toe.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Now left thumb... index finger... middle finger... ring finger... little finger... palm... back of the hand... wrist.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Left forearm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit... left ribs... waist... hip.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Left thigh... knee... shin... calf... ankle... heel... sole... top of the foot... big toe... second... third... fourth... little toe.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel both heels... backs of the legs... backs of the thighs... buttocks... lower back... middle back... upper back... both shoulder blades.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice the belly... navel... lower ribs... centre of the chest... collarbones... throat. Each flower folds inward without being forced.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Bring attention to the jaw... lower lip... upper lip... corners of the mouth... gums... teeth... the whole tongue resting wide and heavy.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the inside of the cheeks... outer cheeks... nose... nostrils... bridge of the nose... space beneath the eyes.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right eyelid... left eyelid... muscles around both eyes... right eyebrow... left eyebrow... space between the eyebrows.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Forehead... right temple... left temple... ears... back of the head... crown... entire scalp. Let every tiny facial muscle stop holding the day.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the whole right side of the body... whole left side... back body... front body... the entire body at once.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [reassuringly] Nothing has to become numb or heavy. Sensation may remain bright. Rest is the permission to stop managing it.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [faint leaves rustling] Imagine moonlight moving slowly across the greenhouse roof while breathing continues beneath every closed flower.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Rest with the whole body as one field of quiet sensation, complete from scalp to toes.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Begin remembering the room around the greenhouse... its sounds... temperature... and the surface carrying you.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Deepen the breath, move fingers and toes, and stretch gently if wanted. Open your eyes as the greenhouse receives first light.
